$schema-note: CloudFormation resource TYPE -> AWS provider resource TYPE(s) mapping for
SEMANTICS. A CFN type is COVERED when at least ONE of its `terraform` names
appears in the Terraform plan census. This is deliberately an OR, not an
AND: idiomatic HCL splits some CFN resources across several provider
resources (AWS::S3::Bucket -> aws_s3_bucket + a dozen aws_s3_bucket_* side
resources) and collapses others into arguments. Requiring all names would
fail on every legitimate partial implementation.
An empty `terraform` array means NO provider resource corresponds to this
CFN type. Such a type can only ever be satisfied by terraform/PARITY_ALLOWLIST.md.
FAILURE DIRECTION. The names here are only ever tested for PRESENCE in the
plan census, so a typo or a stale provider name produces a false FAILURE,
never a false pass. That is the safe direction for a blocking gate: the
harness cannot be silently disarmed by a bad mapping entry.
Names verified against hashicorp/aws 6.60.0 registry docs on 2026-08-14.
CFN types enumerated from cdk/cdk.out/*.template.json (69 types, 539
resources at the default agentcore synth), plus the context-gated compute
variants synthesized with `-c compute_type=ecs` (+2 types) and

AWS::ApiGateway::Method.note: One CFN Method carries the integration and both response shapes inline; the provider splits them into four resources. Any one of them proves the capability is wired.

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Memory.note: CDK's L1 embeds MemoryStrategies inline; the provider hoists each strategy into its own aws_bedrockagentcore_memory_strategy. Both names count.

AWS::CDK::Metadata.note: No provider equivalent by construction — see allowlist.

AWS::CloudFormation::Stack.note: Nested-stack plumbing. Terraform's analogue is a `module` block, which is not a resource and never appears in the plan's resource census — see allowlist.

AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup.note: Provider drops the `Pool` infix: aws_cognito_user_group, not aws_cognito_user_pool_group.

AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup.note: CFN inlines SecurityGroupIngress/Egress; current provider guidance is standalone rule resources. Any of the three counts.

AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment.note: Idiomatic HCL attaches by setting `vpc_id` on aws_internet_gateway, so the attachment usually has no resource of its own; aws_internet_gateway_attachment exists for the split-lifecycle case. This is the archetypal legitimate collapse the type census must tolerate.

AWS::Events::Rule.note: EventBridge lives under the cloudwatch_event_* prefix, and CFN's inline Targets[] become separate aws_cloudwatch_event_target resources.

AWS::IAM::Policy.note: CDK emits AWS::IAM::Policy for inline role policies. Terraform models the same thing as aws_iam_role_policy (inline) or aws_iam_policy + attachment (managed).

AWS::Lambda::Version.note: No provider resource — `publish = true` on aws_lambda_function creates the version. See allowlist.

AWS::Route53Resolver::FirewallRuleGroup.note: CFN inlines FirewallRules[]; the provider hoists each into aws_route53_resolver_firewall_rule.

AWS::S3::Bucket.note: AWS provider v4+ split every bucket sub-configuration into its own resource. One CFN bucket routinely becomes 5-8 provider resources — the reason this harness censuses types and never counts.

AWS::SecretsManager::Secret.note: ABCA provisions secrets as empty shells populated out-of-band, so only aws_secretsmanager_secret is expected. aws_secretsmanager_secret_version is listed for completeness — ADR sub-decision 4 relies on the module NOT managing it (that is what makes the PR 8 GetSecretValue Deny free).

Custom::AWS.note: AwsCustomResource — an arbitrary SDK call, not a resource type. Must be decided case by case; see allowlist.

Custom::AgentCoreRegistry.note: aws_bedrockagentcore_registry DOES exist in provider 6.60.0 but the provider itself marks it deprecated for the agent-registry namespace move. Mapped so that a future implementation satisfies the census without a map edit; allowlisted today with that deprecation as the reason.

Custom::S3AutoDeleteObjects.note: Collapses into `force_destroy = true` on aws_s3_bucket — an argument, not a resource. See allowlist.

Custom::VpcRestrictDefaultSG.note: Mapped so an explicit aws_default_security_group satisfies the census, but the module may equally leave it unmanaged. Allowlisted today.

AWS::Lambda::NetworkConnector.note: No aws_lambda_network_connector in provider 6.60.0 (resource list checked 2026-08-14). Unimplementable, not merely deferred. See allowlist.

AWS::Lambda::MicrovmImage.note: No aws_lambda_microvm_image in provider 6.60.0 (resource list checked 2026-08-14). Unimplementable, not merely deferred. See allowlist.
